name: Zepto

SDE-1.dsaDepth: Heavy — an OA (MCQs + SQL + DSA) then 2 DSA rounds and a hiring-manager round with a live debugging exercise
rounds: Online assessment (90 min): 5 MCQs, 1 SQL question, 3 DSA questions
Interview round 1: string manipulation plus a coin-change variant (return how many of each denomination is used), plus OS questions
Interview round 2: a further DSA/math problem (e.g. removing brackets from a mathematical expression) under time pressure
Hiring-manager round: past-experience discussion, then a live debugging exercise on a shared doc (e.g. spot and fix a Java method-overriding bug and explain the execution flow)
HR round: past experience, other offers, background
extraTopics: Live debugging and explaining code flow, not just fixing the bug
Time management — multiple reports mention running out of time mid-problem
SDE-1.notes: Other reports describe a similar loop with LLD/OOPs and Spring Boot weighted in for slightly more experienced candidates — Zepto is quick-commerce and moves fast, and interview format varies by hiring wave.

Staff Software Engineer (L6).dsaDepth: Heavy — 2 HLD rounds plus 1 LLD round before a hiring-manager round that weighs scalability experience heavily
rounds: Hiring-manager round, evaluated in STAR format, with explicit scrutiny of scalability experience — one candidate was rejected here specifically for insufficient scalability depth despite passing all technical rounds
extraTopics: Scalability experience articulated in STAR format, not just technical HLD/LLD correctness
Fluency describing your own past projects under direct HM questioning
